historical_record.description: Two religious institutional structures (Congregation Beth Sholom) stood at the property.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization for a Planned Unit Development to demolish the structures used as a religious institution and construct a new synagogue at 301-323 14th Avenue.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition of the three-story, single-family structure at 323 14th Avenue.
The City Planning Commission approved the recommendation to the Board of Supervisors of the zoning reclassification to abolish the legislated front setback at 301-323 14th Avenue.
